slides.title: Django Caching
slides.content:
# Caching in Django ⚡

Speed up your app by caching expensive operations!

## Cache Types

| Backend | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Memcached | Distributed memory cache |
| Redis | Key-value store |
| Database | Cache in DB table |
| File | Cache in filesystem |
| Local Memory | In-process cache (dev) |

## Configuration

```python
# settings.py
CACHES = {
    'default': {
        'BACKEND': 'django.core.cache.backends.redis.RedisCache',
        'LOCATION': 'redis://127.0.0.1:6379',
    }
}
```

> 💡 **Caching can make your site 10-100x faster!**

slides.title: Using Cache
slides.content:
# Cache API 🔧

## Low-Level API

```python
from django.core.cache import cache

# Set cache (5 minutes)
cache.set('my_key', 'my_value', 300)

# Get cache
value = cache.get('my_key')  # Returns None if expired
value = cache.get('my_key', 'default')

# Delete cache
cache.delete('my_key')

# Get or set
value = cache.get_or_set('my_key', expensive_function, 300)
```

## View Caching

```python
from django.views.decorators.cache import cache_page

@cache_page(60 * 15)  # Cache for 15 minutes
def my_view(request):
    # Expensive operations
    return render(request, 'template.html')
```

## Template Fragment Caching

```html
{% load cache %}

{% cache 500 sidebar %}
    <!-- Expensive sidebar content -->
{% endcache %}
```

slides.content:
# Excellent Work! 🎉

You've learned Django Caching!

## Cache Backends
- ✅ Redis, Memcached, Database, File

## Caching Methods
- ✅ Low-level: `cache.get()`, `cache.set()`
- ✅ View: `@cache_page`
- ✅ Template: `{% cache %}`

## Best Practices
- 📊 Cache expensive queries
- ⏱️ Set appropriate timeouts
- 🔄 Invalidate on data changes
